title: Count on the beat
description: Every time your hand comes down on a beat (a real measured down stroke) the next number slams into the room behind you, giant, on the side with more space, with the matching word from your list.

props.text: comma list, one word per beat: "Check, Check, Check, Done"

source.note: uses the person matte (drawn behind you, you stay in front) and the body detector through meta "rig"
